question: Does a frozen native10M checkpoint with better free Japanese generation transfer useful short-source predictive distributions to the original Web-oriented10M, while retaining original gold CE on all sources?
rationale: The native staged teacher has markedly better generation/EOS than original-parent CE100M, but fails Web retention and remains unadopted. Unlike Qwen4B representation-transfer, teacher and student have identical native10M architecture, vocab and exact byte codec. Context-dependent soft predictive classes can be transferred without cross-tokenizer/hidden-state alignment. This is an unproven hypothesis; teacher cannot be adopted by substitution.

literature.scope: Reports identically parameterized teacher/student distillation in vision and language modeling. Different tasks/data/training from Japanese10M; not proof of improvement or exact reproduction.
literature.title: Born Again Neural Networks, ICML2018

novelty: Repository source scan shows frozen original-parent Web-KL retention and Qwen3-4B semantic representation-transfer, not frozen staged-native short-source full-vocabulary predictive KD. Preserve those negatives. Same-model capacity/vocab avoids only the alignment difference; no general capacity claim.
objective: All original100M body/EOS gold CE unchanged; add KL(q_frozen_staged_native || p_student) at temperature1, coefficient1, only on existing textbook/story supervised positions. Sum KL over exactly the existing short positions and normalize by all original gold positions in each update, as CE does. No targets/role/BOS/positions/masks/input rewriting. Log original hard gold100M and extra distribution25M positions separately; shared student inputs are not counted twice.
state_and_settings: Same originalparent/4096/model/context1024, freshAdamW LR1e-5 WD.1 constant, seed42 and exact original sampler/teacher order/100M gold positions. Aim existing stablebatch48; must actually measure added frozen-teacher CUDA path and reject if incompatible. Teacher eval/no gradients/weights unchanged, full vocab softtargetsT1, BF16 forward/FP32 logits/loss. Preserve studentoptimizer/scheduler/RNG/sampler/consumedgold andKD counters/teacher hash at completed updates.
supervision_comparison: CE hardgold100M matched. KD adds25M distribution-target positions and teacher forward compute, so not equal total supervision/compute or isolated architecture effect. Same native teacher was trained from a different historical parent/source order; report that history and repeated source exposure. Actual per-position teacher entropy/goldprob/KL/bodyvsEOS reported, not assumed superior gold labels.
protocol_before_science: Implement actual trainer/runner/reviewer/persistentlauncher/fullstate and boundedbatch timing, CPUcheck meaningfulloss/mask/teacherimmutability/accounting/oldfullstates. Reuse fixedTRAIN24 and original1024stress window if needed; no new expensive root-cause assay. ActualCUDA continuous4vs2+2 allweights/Adam/scheduler/RNG/fullsampler/digest/gold/KD/finite history and frozen-teacher unchanged checks, worstbatch finite BF16, discard probe weights. Confirm all100M original gold streams/cursors equal cachedCE at terminal; no cachedcontrolGPU/rating rerun.

preliminary_limits.science_cap: Freeze from actual measured total100M/update/evaluation cost, <=remaining3600; if forecast exceeds cap, close budget condition without raisingcap/batch/teacher/shape rescue

evaluation: Same common256DEV/472055bytes/122343tokens, Japanese192/331/1119, fixed80 plainBOS/greedy64/EOS3/suppress0,1,2,4,5,6,7 and all80 individually raw-bound nonblind notes. Exact reused raw outputs alone may reuse old ratings. All matchedCE/strong/absolute/historicalWeb guards unchanged; independent trainedseed/fullDEV/protectedTEST/adoption only after qualified science.
completion: Actual immutable full100M terminal, gold/KD/input/bytes/fullstate/cursors/timings, all evaluation/content/gates, originalWebUI restored, portable evidence and localcommit. Passing research comparison is not Base completion.
failure_policy: One native teacher/T1/coefficient1/same100M condition. No teacher/temperature/alpha/LR/parent/data/batch/shape/cap/checkpoint/threshold sweep or automatic extra learning if failed. Preserve oldclosedKD/WebKL/numeric7 and all historical negatives.
